anchors.anchor_tiller_grip: centre of the manual-mode push handle on the compute tower (hand point; walk-behind), child of body

hierarchy: pallet_stacker_auto > body > {steer_drive > wheel_drive, caster_L > wheel_caster_L, caster_R > wheel_caster_R, light_strip, lidar, mast_outer > mast_inner > fork_carriage}

rig.drive: move/rotate body (or root); rear drive wheel steers like a forklift rear axle; the fixed axle is the fork-side load rollers / mast legs (z +0.42 m glTF)
rig.steer: rotate steer_drive about local Y (+-90 deg); casters caster_L/R swivel freely about Y (point them along the velocity)
rig.spin: rotate wheel_drive (r 0.15 m) / wheel_caster_L/R (r 0.07 m) about local X
rig.lift: two-stage: (1) free lift - translate fork_carriage +Y 0..1.30 m (carriage frame stays inside the inner rails: top 1.92 < rail top 1.96); (2) translate mast_inner +Y 0..1.60 m (keeps 0.30 m overlap in the outer rails, lift rod stays in its cylinder). Max fork height 2.90 m; lift only when speed < 0.05 m/s

nodes.body: chassis + orange shell + tower, origin ground centre of chassis
nodes.steer_drive: drive-wheel yoke; origin at the drive axle centre (x=0, y=0.15, z=-0.62 glTF) on the vertical steer axis; rotate about Y
nodes.wheel_drive: child of steer_drive, origin at axle centre, spin about X
nodes.caster_L/R: swivel yokes, origin at caster axle centre on the swivel axis; wheel_caster_L/R children spin about X
nodes.light_strip: emissive cyan perimeter strip (material strip_cyan) - recolour/blink
nodes.lidar: sensor arch + top lidar puck; origin at puck centre - spin about Y
nodes.mast_outer: child of body, fixed outer uprights + lift cylinder; origin at mast foot on the ground (x=0, z=+0.42 glTF)
nodes.mast_inner: child of mast_outer, inner uprights + crosshead + chains + lift rod; origin at mast foot; translate +Y 0..1.60 m
nodes.fork_carriage: child of mast_inner; carriage, backrest, guide rollers, 2 tines (1.07 m x 0.12 x 0.06 m, tapered tips); origin at the fork heel on the ground; translate +Y 0..1.30 m (free lift)
